posts.title: Why LLMs Are Unreliable Language Detectors
posts.description: LLMs can translate, explain grammar, and write fluently in dozens of languages — so it seems obvious they should be great at simply identifying what language a text is written in. And for long, clean text in common languages, they usually are.
